entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has landed in Auckland for a whirlwind visit | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?subscribe 

It's the first visit by an Indian prime minister for 40 years and the third visit overall after previous trips by Indira Gandhi in 1968 and then later her son, Rajiv, in 1986.

Read more: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/indonz/697510/narendra-modi-arrives-for-historic-visit-to-new-zealand

Video: Blessen Tom
